title: Acrylic Procreate Brushes: Painting Kit
author: Eve Zo Art
description:
✅ Professional Realistic Acrylic Procreate Brushes – Digital Painting Kit
Transform your iPad into a professional art studio! Create stunning, authentic-looking acrylic illustrations with this complete Acrylic Painting Studio for Procreate.
This collection has been meticulously crafted to mimic the rich textures, heavy impasto, and smooth blending of traditional acrylic paint. Whether you are a beginner or a professional illustrator, these essential tools provide everything needed for a realistic “thick paint” effect without any complicated setup.
✅ This Realistic Acrylic Pack Includes:
12 High-Quality Acrylic Brushes: (.brushset) featuring textures from thick impasto and dry brush to smooth, diluted washes.
1 Magic Canvas: (.procreate) Pre-textured to simulate a professional primed canvas surface for instant realism.
Two High-Resolution Canvas Sizes: 6364×4500 px and 4243×3000 px at 300 DPI.
7 Professional Color Palettes: (.swatches) Hand-picked for a classic acrylic artist’s setup.
10 Ready-to-Use Sketches: (Transparent PNGs) Perfect for quick-start inspiration and practice.
Detailed User Guide: (PDF) Simple instructions for easy installation.
✅ Instant Direct Download:
Your purchase includes a single ZIP file containing all brushes, canvases, and resources. Simply download and import directly into Procreate to start your creative journey immediately!
✅ Compatibility:
Specifically designed for Procreate 5 or newer on all iPad models that support the app.
🖌️ Showcase your art! Tag your creations on Instagram: evezoriart—it is a joy to see what you create.
🎨 If you have any questions or need assistance, please feel free to message me.
Happy Painting!
